review_candidates.title: IT Incident, Problem & Change Manager
review_candidates.description: How do you create calm, clarity and accountability when technology disruption matters most? At EBOS Group, Our IT and technology teams supports one of Australasia's most diverse healthcare, medical, pharmaceutical and animal care organisations. We are looking for an experienced IT Incident, Problem & Change Manager to help strengthen the practices that protect service stability, manage technology risk and improve operational resilience across our enterprise environment. This is an opportunity to combine hands-on major incident leadership with ownership of incident, problem and change management practices across a complex technology landscape. You will work across technology teams, business stakeholders and external partners to minimise disruption, improve responsiveness and ensure lessons learned translate into meaningful operational improvement. The Role You will play a critical role in how EBOS responds to, manages, and learns from technology disruptions and service issues. From coordinating major incident responses and senior stakeholder communications, through to leading Post Incident Reviews, Problem Management activities, root cause investigations, known error management, and preventative actions, you will be responsible for helping create a more resilient, stable, and effective technology environment. You will also oversee Change Management governance, facilitate Change Advisory Board (CAB) activities, assess risk and impact, and work with stakeholders across the organisation to ensure technology changes are delivered safely and successfully. In addition, you will drive the maturity of the Problem Management process, ensuring recurring issues are identified, investigated, and resolved through structured analysis and continual service improvement. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Service Assurance, this role sits within Core Technology Services and works closely with teams across the broader technology function and business operations. The position is based in Docklands, Melbourne and participates in a 24/7 on-call roster. What You'll Be Doing Lead and coordinate major incident responses, ensuring clear communication and effective stakeholder management. Facilitate Post Incident Reviews, root cause investigations, problem records, and continuous improvement initiatives. Drive improvements across Incident, Problem, and Change Management processes, governance, reporting, and process maturity. Chair and facilitate Incident, Problem, Change Advisory Board (CAB), and service review forums. Identify, investigate, and manage recurring incidents and service trends through structured Problem Management practices. Maintain the Known Error Database (KEDB), ensuring known errors, workarounds, corrective actions, and preventative measures are documented, tracked, and communicated. Lead root cause analysis activities and coordinate cross-functional teams to implement sustainable resolutions and reduce repeat incidents. Monitor process performance, SLA adherence, recurring incident trends, and operational outcomes through reporting and analysis. Develop and report on key Problem Management metrics, including recurring incidents, aged problems, root cause completion, and reduction of service disruptions. Support technology readiness and response activities associated with business emergency management exercises. Coach and support Incident Managers, Problem Managers, Change Managers, and on-call participants in ITSM best practices. Partner with technology teams, vendors, and business stakeholders to identify systemic risks and drive preventative improvements. Identify opportunities to improve service management practices, reduce manual effort, increase operational effectiveness, and enhance service resilience. What You'll Bring You are an experienced service management professional who can confidently lead through complex situations while maintaining focus on long-term improvement. You'll bring: Demonstrated experience in major incident management, problem management and/or change management within a corporate or enterprise environment. ITIL certification and strong practical knowledge of IT Service Management principles. If you believe that you have the necessary attributes to succeed in this challenging and rewarding role, please click ‘APPLY’ now and submit your application. Pre-employment checks may be required and will be discussed with the successful candidate. We are unable to proceed with your application if your current visa restrictions preclude you from being able to perform the role in line with immigration laws. No agency assistance required.

review_candidates.description: Italian Exhibition Group SpA, il più importante Exhibition & Convention provider italiano per eventi fieristico-congressuali in proprietà, quotato su Euronext Milan, sta cercando un FACILITY MANAGEMENT & EXHIBITION OPERATIONS SPECIALIST da inserire presso il quartiere Fieristico di Vicenza. PRINCIPALI ATTIVITA’: Supporta le funzioni coinvolte, nello sviluppo del layout generale di manifestazione e ne controlla on site la corretta predisposizione Collabora con il team Logistics nella pianificazione delle attività di allestimento ed erogazione servizi, supervisionando il corretto andamento dei lavori nel rispetto del programma stabilito Verifica i progetti di Allestimento, garantendone il rispetto del Regolamento Tecnico di Quartiere Analizza le richieste di servizi che accompagnano i progetti di Allestimento stand o le aree Evento in generale, con particolare riferimento alle richieste di natura elettrica, idrica e connettività dati, ne verifica la fattibilità collaborando con i fornitori interni dedicati all’erogazione dei servizi stessi. Supporta il team commerciale nella fase di vendita, per tutti gli aspetti di natura Tecnica e Logistica. PROFILO RICERCATO: Titoli di studio: Diploma o Laurea in materie Tecniche o Gestionali Esperienza anche non approfondita nel settore impiantistico Conoscenze: utilizzo evoluto del pacchetto Office (in particolare Excel), Autocad, Planner Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. COMPLETANO IL PROFILO: Flessibilità e problem solving; Predisposizione all’apprendimento Spiccate capacità organizzative e di lavoro in team COSA OFFRIAMO: Il CCNL di riferimento è il Contratto Collettivo Nazionale di lavoro per i dipendenti da aziende del Terziario della Distribuzione e dei Servizi (CNEL H011). Trattamento economico: RAL compresa tra 25.000€ e 35.000€ , definita in base all’esperienza, alle competenze e al livello di seniority del candidato selezionato. Premi individuali, premi collettivi e Welfare aziendale. Buoni pasto da 8,00 € per ogni giorno lavorato. Flessibilità oraria e attenzione al work-life balance. Formazione dedicata. SEDE: VICENZA Il trattamento dei dati personali avverrà nel rispetto del Regolamento UE Privacy, 679/2016, GDPR . Il presente annuncio è rivolto ad entrambi i sessi, ai sensi delle leggi 903/77 e 125/91, e a persone di tutte le età e tutte le nazionalità, ai sensi dei decreti legislativi 215/03 e 216/03.
